notes.title: Begin your Journey to Immortality here. Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
hello everyone，

In order to bring you all a better experience, we've devoted ourselves into [i]Taoism[/i] and [i]The Mortal's Journey to Immortality[/i] for a long time.

We've added lots of content in the game, including house-building, pharmacy, alchemy, beast-taming, livestock-breeding, etc.
The more substantial the contents of the game are, the closer the meeting day of us is.
We realize that different people have different understanding of Journey to Immortality, thus we would try our best to make [i]Oriental Immortal[/i] a better one and live up to your expectation!

Get your path of cultivation start with the video below:

[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1PG4y1b7mF/]Begin your Journey to Immortality here and Wishlist Now![/url]
